question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
WITH target_cities AS (
    SELECT city_id FROM city WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
target_addresses AS (
    SELECT a.address_id FROM address a JOIN target_cities tc ON a.city_id = tc.city_id
),
target_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id FROM customer c JOIN target_addresses ta ON c.address_id = ta.address_id
),
rental_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.category_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0 AS hours
    FROM rental r
    JOIN target_customers tc ON r.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category rc ON fc.category_id = rc.category_id
    WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(rh.hours) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental_hours rh
JOIN category c ON rh.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1
